text.en: This Statute may be cited as the Kolej U niversiti Perguruan U gama Seri Begawan (Establishment Board) Statute, 2011.

In this Statute, unless the context otherwise requires - "Constitution" means the Constitution of the Kolej Universiti set out in the Schedule of the Order; the Council of the Kolej Universiti constituted in with section 15(1) of the Constitution; "Kolej Universiti" means Kolej Universiti Perguruan Ugama Seri Begawan by section 3 of the Order; the Kolej Universiti Perguruan Ugama Seri Begawan Order, 2008 (S 84/08). Board.
There shall be an Establishment Board (hereinafter referred to as "the Board"! constituted as an authority of the Kolej Universiti under section 14(1) of the Constitution. of Board.

! 1) The Board shall consist of - {a} the Ra'es as Chairman; {b} the Chairman of the Public Service Commission or his 1st. ~lARCH, 2011 (cJ the Director-General of Public Service or his representative; and (dJ one member of the Council other than the Director-General of Public Service or his representative, who shall hold office for such period as the Council may determine.

(2) The Registrar or his representative shall be the Secretary to the Board.

(3) The Chairman may appoint any member of the Board to deputise for him as Chairman at any meeting of the Board. at meetings by invitation.
The Chairman may invite any person to attend a meeting of the Board provided that such person shall have no voting right. of Board.

The Board shall be responsible for making recommendations to the Council on all establishment matters concerning Kolej Universiti staff, including the following matters ..._ (aJ confirmation of staff in their posts on the permanent establishment; (bJ placement of staff on the pensionable establishment in respect of staff who were appointed to posts on the permanent establishment prior to (cJ promotion withJn a scheme of service; (dJ review for adjustment of salaries; (eJ crossing of efficiency bars in salary scales; (fJ renewal and termination of service contracts; and (gJ implementation of staff merit schemes as may be approved from time to the CounciL
3 members of the Board shall constitute a quorum for any meeting of the of meetings.

The minutes of meetings of the Board shall be submitted to the CounciL Made this 17th. day of Muharram, 1432 Hijriah corresponding to the 22nd. day of January, 2011.

AND YANG DI-PERTUAN

BRUNEI DARUSSALAM Kolej Universiti Perguruan Ugama Seri Begawan. Dicetak oleh PENGIRAN HAJI ZAINAL ABIDIN BIN PENGIRAN SERI WIJAYA HAJI AHMAD, Pemangku Pengarah Percetakan, di Jabatan Pe.n::etakan Kerajaan, Bandnr Seri Begawan BB3510, Negara Brunei Darussalam.
